name: studysync
description: AI-powered exam paper OCR and step-by-step solutions for web, mobile and desktop.

scripts.install:server: cd server && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run server" "npm run web"
scripts.desktop: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix desktop start
